messages:
Alice: Quick sync — we need to finalize onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Legal, billing, images, AMIs, support. Who can own which lane? cc @Diego @Priya
Diego: I can lead legal. Need EULA draft + SOC attestation copies. Also confirm data residency requirements per region.
Priya: I'll take AMIs/VM images and cloud packaging. Need finalized instance types and quant profiles from runtime team.
Mark: I'll plug in pricing SKUs and entitlements. Can we get SKU mapping for consumption vs reserved?
MarketplaceBot: Required artifacts for cloud listings: Seller ID, Offer ID, Pricing CSV, Asset manifest, Support contact, Security docs. See https://partners.example.com/onboard
Alice: Adding a quick checklist:
``` 
- Seller IDs (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Pricing CSV + SKU mapping
- Asset manifests + logos
- AMI/Images + test deploy script
- EULA & Privacy
- Support & Ops contact
- Entitlement mapping
- Billing/Tax contact
```
Please add owners.
Priya: putting owners inline: AMIs -> Priya; test deploy -> EngOps; images -> Design for logos.
Diego: Legal -> Diego; EULA -> Legal; Privacy -> Security for review.
Jen: Marketing will provide 2x screenshots, 1x one-liner, 150-word description. ETA EOD Wed.
Mark: Question on pricing: do we publish both on-demand and reserved offers? Also need clarity on billing currency and tax metadata.
Alice: Plan: target soft listing in staging accounts by next Tues. Action items:
- Diego: EULA + attestation (due Fri)
- Priya: AMIs + deploy script (due Mon)
- Mark: Pricing CSV + SKUs (due Mon)
- Jen: creative + description (due Wed)
- EngOps: run verification tests (due Tue)
Please react :eyes: when you accept.
Diego: Accepted :+1: will start draft today.
Priya: Accepted :rocket:
Mark: Accepted. Adding a note — need Finance to confirm tax codes. @Finance?
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: once artifacts uploaded, run manifest validator: `./validate_manifest.sh manifest.json`
Alice: Thanks all — I'll follow up with calendar invite for 30m review tomorrow. Closing thread for now.
